scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.db:migrate:local: printf 'y\n' | wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:prod: printf 'y\n' | wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Telegram bot token from @BotFather. Stored as a Worker secret.

BOT_ADMIN_IDS.description: Optional comma-separated Telegram numeric user IDs allowed to manage bot settings in groups. Leave empty to require Telegram group-admin status.
